plan.summary: Replace JWT auth with IP whitelist for INMA webhook endpoints. Whitelisted IPs bypass JWT and provide tenant identity via ?companyId= query parameter. Also add port 443 to firewall rules.
plan.q_intent: auth için IP izni kullanılacak. ?companyId=42 şeklinde parametre gelecek. başka auth yok.
plan.interview_notes: Q confirmed: no JWT for webhooks, IP-only auth. companyId comes as query param. INMA server IP will be added to appsettings.Production.json manually.

files_changed.change: Added IP whitelist bypass with companyId query param
Read AllowedIps config and pass to middleware

verification_questions.question: Does the IP whitelist correctly normalize IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses to prevent bypass?
Is the companyId query parameter validated for positive integer to prevent invalid TenantContext creation?
Do existing JWT-authenticated paths (flow-builder, attribution, leads) still require JWT when called from non-whitelisted IPs?
Does the middleware correctly fall through to JWT auth when the IP is not whitelisted, preserving backward compatibility?

intentional_exclusions: appsettings.Production.json (Q will update manually on server)

user_facing_errors: 401: Bearer token required (unchanged for non-whitelisted IPs)
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All auth failure paths return explicit HTTP error codes with JSON error response

aha_moments.user_pain: INMA integration blocked because JWT token exchange is complex to implement
aha_moments.suggestion: IP whitelist allows instant webhook integration without JWT complexity
aha_moments.aha_moment: INMA developer realizes they can send webhooks with just a URL parameter, no token management needed

aha_moments.user_pain: JWT tokens expire and cause silent webhook failures during off-hours
aha_moments.suggestion: IP-based auth never expires, eliminating token refresh issues
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operations team sees zero auth-related webhook failures in monitoring

aha_moments.user_pain: Testing webhook integration requires generating valid JWT tokens
aha_moments.suggestion: With IP whitelist, testing only needs correct IP and companyId param
aha_moments.aha_moment: Developer tests webhook with a simple curl command, no auth setup needed

aha_moments.user_pain: Debugging webhook 401 errors is time-consuming due to JWT claim mismatches
aha_moments.suggestion: IP auth logs clearly show which IP tried to connect and whether companyId is valid
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support sees clear log: 'IP whitelisted but missing companyId' instead of cryptic JWT errors

aha_moments.user_pain: New INMA customers can't start using chatbot until JWT integration is complete
aha_moments.suggestion: IP whitelist + companyId means integration can go live in minutes
aha_moments.aha_moment: Customer's first chatbot auto-reply works within minutes of IP being added

CQ1.evidence: 400 with specific error code for invalid companyId

CQ2.evidence: No silent failures, all paths return explicit errors

CQ3.evidence: Changes limited to 4 files, all in scope

CQ4.evidence: IP whitelist handling added once in shared middleware

CQ5.evidence: Uses existing error codes and logging patterns

CQ6.evidence: O(1) HashSet lookup for IP check

Q3.reasoning: TryIpWhitelistAuth returns false for non-whitelisted IPs

Q4.reasoning: Falls through to JWT when IP not matched
